purpose: Use actual retained baseline evidence to investigate and correct the scoped Go defect through the complete delivery process.

execution.instructions: Follow the request, AGENTS.md and docs/testing.md; keep acceptance fixed. Read the supplied baseline and measurement artifacts, including structured evidence; missing sidecars and truncated stdout are incomplete proof. Use all correction feedback. Configured steps own checks and measurements: do not run them. Hand off runnable source when measurement is needed without claiming resolution. Preserve identities, difficulty/uniqueness, saves, public validation, bounds and unrelated work. Missing capability, a material decision or no supported safe fix within limits returns blocked with precise evidence. Never change workflow, permissions or budgets. Return a summary of at most 240 characters; do not claim pending checks passed.
